title: Sunrise Walk
description: Tibetan Buddhist monks walk around the Boudhanath Stupa at sunrise in Kathmandu, Nepal. The ritual is a form of walking meditation known as kora and is performed in a clockwise direction by monks and other Buddhist worshippers. Kora can take place around any sacred site or object. The Boudhanath Stupa is a popular pilgrimage destination, but Mount Kailash in China is considered one of the most sacred sites for Tibetan Buddhists.
translated_description: 藏传佛教僧侣在尼泊尔加德满都的博大哈佛塔旁于日出时分绕行。这一仪式是一种称为“转经”的步行冥想形式，僧侣及其他佛教信徒按顺时针方向进行。转经可围绕任何圣地或圣物进行。博大哈佛塔是热门的朝圣之地，而中国的冈仁波齐峰则被视为藏传佛教最神圣的地点之一。
